observed: Result: Passed on production (v26.43.0-ffea43c), following the test's steps with the keyboard (mouse only for set-up and for switching to Tech View in step 5, as the test allows).

Set-up: work order S1-1698 for "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Controls One", Approved, led by ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha, who is also on its line; Ana unpinned at the start; All tab, Board View, the customer's name in Search, at Truck Hill 1, window 1600 px wide.

Step 1: Tab from Search went through the toolbar and landed on S1-1698's card (no column header on the way); the card shows a blue focus ring and its More actions (…) button shows with the mouse moved away.

Step 2: Tab reached More actions; Enter opened the menu (Reassign lead technician, Unassign) and Escape closed it with focus back on More actions; Space opened it again and Escape closed it, focus back on More actions.
Step 3: from the card, the Up arrow reached Ana's column header; Tab reached its pin button; Enter pinned Ana (pin shown pressed, Ana's column moved first).
Step 4: with focus kept on the pin, Space unpinned Ana.

Step 5: Tech View was clicked (and Assigned Techs turned on as set-up); Tab from Search landed on S1-1698's row, the Up arrow reached Ana's group header, Tab reached its collapse arrow, and Enter collapsed the group (its row hidden).
Step 6: with focus kept on the arrow, Space expanded the group again (the row is back).
Step 7: the Down arrow reached S1-1698's row and Tab reached the avatar in Assigned Techs; it shows the name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha".
Step 8: Shift+Tab reached Column Selection; Enter opened its options, Tab moved into them (On Site switch), and Escape closed them with focus back on Column Selection.

Step 9: Tab reached Status; Enter opened it, Tab reached Estimate then Approved, Enter ticked Approved (chip "Status: Approved"); Escape closed the options with focus on the chip; Tab reached its x and Enter cleared the filter (chip back to "Status").
Step 10: Shift+Tab reached the Board View switcher button and Enter changed the display to Board View.
